note: The archive manifest for the benchmark gate. archived_at_commit names the commit whose code the archived measurements were taken on; monitored_paths name the files whose changes plausibly alter session/latency behavior. The gate (scripts/benchmark_archive_gate.py) answers one question: does the archive still cover the code it is attached to? If a monitored file changes, re-run scripts/bench.py, archive the raw JSON here, add it to archive_files and advance archived_at_commit. Widening monitored_paths is itself a manifest change: if the new paths differ since the archive, the gate goes REGRESSION until it is re-archived. An empty monitored_paths list would make the gate vacuous and is rejected as infrastructure.
